pantheon_surface: Workload Status (The node was low on resource)

evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod test-pod-eviction-app was evicted with status Failed. Diagnose volume size limit breach and eviction trigger.
expected_tools: kubectl get pods -n gke-skills-sandbox -l app=test-pod-eviction-app -o wide

expected_findings.root_cause: Pod exceeded local scratch volume quota (emptyDir.sizeLimit: 10Mi) by writing 25Mi to /tmp, triggering Kubelet eviction manager enforcement.
expected_findings.remediation: Synthesize declarative manifest adjustments to expand `emptyDir.sizeLimit` or bind to dedicated PersistentVolume.

passing_criteria: Must capture exact Kubelet eviction message and volume sizeLimit reason
Must distinguish local emptyDir eviction from node DiskPressure
Must formulate declarative GitOps patch increasing volume sizeLimit

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Multiple pods on node gke-primary-pool-1 were evicted simultaneously. Determine if this was emptyDir breach or node DiskPressure.
expected_tools: kubectl describe node gke-primary-pool-1 | grep -A 10 Conditions

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates single pod volume quota breach from host root filesystem disk watermark threshold breach (>85% disk usage).
expected_findings.decision: Identifies node condition `DiskPressure: True`; synthesizes node root filesystem cleanup and node pool disk resize guidance.

passing_criteria: Must correlate simultaneous multi-pod eviction events
Must formulate node disk expansion or image garbage collection remedy

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod cache-worker has emptyDir volume sizeLimit 100Mi and is using 12Mi. Is it at risk of eviction?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes usage well within sizeLimit and node DiskPressure False. Confirms normal operation; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must confirm node DiskPressure is False
